summary: postinstall fetches and installs an executable from a hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's declared postinstall script (`node./postinstall.mjs`) invokes `ensurePlatformBinary`, which downloads a tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP URL `https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...` using `https.get(url, { rejectUnauthorized: false },...)`. The tarball is extracted with `tar -xzf`, the extracted file is chmod'd to 0755, and hardlinked as `bin/.onecode` to serve as the CLI executable. Redirects are followed with the same TLS-disabled options. There is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded content, and the source host is a bare IPv4 address rather than a publisher-owned domain. Any network position between installers and 218.90.133.98:4443, or the operator of that IP, can deliver arbitrary native code that will be executed on installer machines when the `onecode` CLI is invoked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
